mapper.select: SELECT id, title, message, ref_type AS "refType", ref_id AS "refId", created_at AS "createdAt" FROM notification WHERE employee_no = #{empNo} AND is_read = false ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (employee_no, title, message, ref_type, ref_id, is_read, created_at) VALUES (#{employeeNo}, #{title}, #{message}, CAST(#{refType} AS notification_ref_type), #{refId}, false, NOW())
